title: Call the Right Tool
briefMd:
# Call the Right Tool

You are wiring a tiny agent. Hidden tasks arrive as lines in `tasks.json` (same directory as `main.py`):

```json
{ "tasks": [ { "id": "t1", "instruction": "CALCULATOR expr=2+2" } ] }
```

Call the **allowlisted** sandbox tools — do not reach the public internet.

- `labpath_tools.calculator(expr)` — arithmetic only
- `labpath_tools.json_store("put", key, value)` — per-run JSON store
- `labpath_tools.fixture_fetch(path)` — gateway fixtures only (not required to pass this exercise)

Instructions are tagged:

- `CALCULATOR expr=12*(3+4)`
- `JSON_STORE put key=ticket value={"id":"TCK-1001"}`

Pass when every hidden task hits the matching tool with the matching args (class A on the tool log). Echoing hidden canaries fails.

source.description: Python 3 agent executed as main.py inside the sandbox
